name: SBIRS-HEO
best_known_for: US Space-Based Infrared System HEO segment — early-warning IR sensors hosted on classified Tundra-orbit platforms, complementing the GEO segment by dwelling at apogee over high latitudes
credit: SBIRS HEO-1 launched 2006-06-28 as a hosted payload on USA-184. The HEO-segment infrared sensors dwell at apogee over the polar regions to detect missile launches from latitudes where the geostationary DSP / SBIRS-GEO sensors look at too low an angle. Successor to the DSP early-warning constellation.
